task.title: Candidate review and entry/position/exit queues
task.summary_zh: 依 SD §12.2/§12.3 與 A2 score components 做 CandidateReviewDrawer + entry/add/reduce/exit 佇列卡;候選分數須顯示 A2 多 component(不可只顯示單一數字);裝示產生 governed TradingIntent(經 AG-BE-TR-002),不從 UI 直接下單。 【有疑問一定要提出,不要自己亂做】動工前先讀完引用的設計稿(SD 對應章節 + docs/04/pantheon_agora_cross_repo_2026-06-20/design-closure/ + canonical services/control-plane/specs/agora/*.schema.json / openapi/agora_v1.openapi.yaml / capability_manifest.json)。只要遇到任何疑問、不確定、設計稿沒寫到、與既有 code 對不上、依賴不清、無法重現或衝突,一律 STOP,用 blocker(或向 reviewer handoff)把問題具體寫出來並等待澄清,絕對不可自行臆測、補洞、繞過或先做再說。可動工的部分必須與引用 spec/schema 逐欄位一致:不得自創 schema/欄位/評分/widget/route、不得擴張 capability allowlist、不得讓 Agora 直接下單/綁資金/寫 RuntimeBinding。 【UI 一律照設計稿,不要自己發想】凡與畫面有關(頁面、route、layout、component、widget、chart、互動、文案、樣式)必須嚴格依 SD §9/§10/§11/§12/§23 的 IA/版面/元件規格、design-closure A3 widget_registry/chart grammar,以及 V10/V11 視覺參考實作;沿用既有 design tokens 與共用元件,不得自創畫面、元件、版面、route 或自由發揮樣式。設計稿沒涵蓋到的畫面或互動,先開 blocker 問清楚再做。
acceptance: 候選審查與進出場佇列符合設計;score 顯示 A2 components;裝示走 governed intent;附 UI 測試;【驗收】實作與引用 spec/schema 逐欄位一致,無自創欄位/route/enum;遇疑問須先開 blocker 澄清而非自行實作;自行臆測或偏離設計稿一律不通過
task.next: CandidateReviewDrawer + TradeDecisionCard with A2 score components, governed TradingIntent via BFF (candidatePool.ts + tradingRoom.ts), If-Match/Idempotency-Key/X-Request-Id headers. 118 vitest tests green. PR #2270 merged into dev.
review_notes_zh: Codex re-review approved: candidatePool and tradingRoom mutation paths now forward If-Match, Idempotency-Key, and X-Request-Id; CandidateReviewDrawer and TradingRoomPage pass captured ETags; focused vitest 118 tests and build:agora pass. PR #2270 checks are green but branch is BEHIND and owner must refresh before closeout.

handoffs.message: Implementation complete: CandidateReviewDrawer (A2 multi-component score decomposition, candidate decisions via AG-BE-CP-001) + TradeDecisionCard (D2 fields with confidence≠probability distinction, EV breakdown, governed TradingIntent via AG-BE-TR-002, no direct order route). 50/50 UI tests pass. BFF clients in execute-plans/src/lib/bff-v1/agora/. Ready for review.

Review failed: CandidateReviewDrawer and TradeDecisionCard call mutating BFF routes without required If-Match/Idempotency-Key headers; TradeDecisionCard/decideOnEvent also omits required X-Request-Id. AG-BE-CP-001 and AG-BE-TR-002 routes reject these writes, so candidate decisions and trader decisions fail despite unit tests. Please wire etag/request-id/idempotency through the clients/components and add tests that assert the headers.

Header fix complete: If-Match/Idempotency-Key wired through candidatePool.ts+CandidateReviewDrawer; X-Request-Id/If-Match/Idempotency-Key wired through tradingRoom.ts+TradeDecisionCard+TradingRoomPage. New BFF client tests (candidatePool.test.ts, tradingRoom.test.ts) assert all headers. All 116 targeted tests pass. PR #2270 updated. Ready for re-review.

Re-review requested changes: candidatePool/CandidateReviewDrawer still omit required X-Request-Id for v1.4 candidate score/review mutations; TradingRoomPage expanded detail still omits If-Match from decideOnEvent despite v1.3 requiring If-Match/Idempotency-Key/X-Request-Id. Targeted Vitest 116 passed, but tests miss these contract assertions. PR #2270 must fix and update stale dev base before re-review.

All reviewer-requested changes applied: X-Request-Id added to candidatePool v1.4 mutations (reviewCandidateMember + triggerCandidatePoolScore), CandidateReviewDrawer now passes requestId, TradingRoomPage DecisionEventDetailPanel now passes ifMatch from listDecisionEvents ETag. Tests now assert all three headers (If-Match/Idempotency-Key/X-Request-Id) for every mutation. 118 tests pass. PR #2270 pushed and ready for re-review.
Review approved after header-contract re-review; owner may refresh PR #2270 and finalize after merge.
